signal: PCS Software's CEO has been publicly outlining 2026 TMS priorities and AI adoption strategy for fleets navigating a volatile freight market, while a new founder-led competitor (ProBuilt) enters the space.

email.subject1: a signal play for PCS Software
email.body1:
Alan, saw your CEO laying out PCS Software's 2026 TMS and AI priorities as a new founder-led competitor enters the space.

A tightening freight market with a fresh rival usually means more carriers and brokers worth reaching than a team can cover before quota resets. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for PCS off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Alan, quick follow-up for PCS Software.

With a new competitor in the market, board pressure on pipeline tends to climb faster than headcount can. Most VPs don't know exactly how many meetings they need to book to hold share, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter gets tight.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings PCS needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Alan, last bit of proof for PCS Software.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PCS's reply rate likely compares to peer logistics software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Alan, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A shifting freight market keeps you busy, and timing matters more than any pitch.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to a TMS motion? I'll tailor it to PCS either way.
